name: Zombie Island
summary: Zombie Island is not a classic zombie game, either. Its main peculiarity is the main character. It is a friendly and curious Zombie who dreams to become a Human and find his Love. Zombie Island is by far the most peaceful, cute, and friendly game about zombies. The main idea of the game states “Help Zombie Become a Human!” Once your Zombie becomes a Human, he gets his own brain, so other zombies cannot bury him anymore, yet his outlook of a zombie doesn’t change
